historical_reviews.deepseek: YES; shows handle text without device identity, sentinel distinction or target resolution.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; adds FFFEh/FFFFh distinction and per-device Type 18/33 resolution but lowers capability for pending inputs.

original_test_intent: Verify for every Type 17 memory device that Memory Error Information Handle correctly encodes FFFEh for no provided error structure, FFFFh for no detected error, or uniquely references the intended Type 18/33 record for that device, and remains correctly associated after reboot.
original_method: Capture complete raw Type 17/18/33 data and SMBIOS version; bind each handle to stable device/socket identity, distinguish both sentinels, uniquely resolve ordinary handles and correlate their device/address scope, then repeat after reboot without injecting faults or clearing history.
manual_activity: A user approves expected per-device diagnostic state and reboot plan. Fault injection and physical memory handling are not authorized.
required_inputs: Applicable SMBIOS version and permitted Type 18/33 target policy
Expected FFFEh, FFFFh or existing-record state per device class
Stable device identity using locator, array handle and population context
Policy for correlating a real record to the correct device/address range
Raw-capable parser and approved reboot/OOB recovery
safety_requirements: Use read-only SMBIOS/EDAC/kernel collection; never inject a memory error.
Do not clear or reset firmware, BMC, EDAC or kernel error history.
Keep FFFEh and FFFFh distinct and preserve their raw values.
Require every ordinary handle to resolve once to an allowed error structure and verify device/address association where fields permit.
Stop on dangling/duplicate/wrong-device references or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Classify every raw sentinel, resolve ordinary handles, preserve linked error fields and correlate device identity before and after reboot.
Do not create errors, erase history, alter ECC policy or issue PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the expected per-device error state and version-specific Type 18/33 interpretation.
Approve reboot/recovery, assess real diagnostic records and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The field label is relevant, but grep -A1 loses the enclosing Type 17 locator/array identity and cannot distinguish or resolve handle semantics.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive complete raw/decoded Type 17/18/33 data; report device locator, array handle, population state, raw error handle, exact sentinel meaning or unique target and correlation result.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The per-device handle scope, Type 17 script and 5/5-minute values are retained; source log clearing is rejected because it would destroy relevant evidence.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Evaluate each Type 17 error handle in its locator/array context, distinguish FFFEh/FFFFh, resolve all other values to unique permitted error records and compare semantic association after reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 17 device records with optional Type 18/33 memory-error records.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS/BMC, parser/dmidecode, kernel and EDAC versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 17 Memory Error Information Handle sentinel semantics and Type 18/33 record definitions.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds per-device identity, raw sentinel semantics, referential integrity and target correlation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects conflated sentinels, dangling/duplicate targets and error records linked to the wrong DIMM/socket.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Expected diagnostic state and version-aware target/correlation policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Valid metadata does not prove future error detection; a linked historical record may legitimately change when real platform events occur and must be engineer-interpreted.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve expected historical records or sentinel states by device class, but must not manufacture an error merely to replace a sentinel; legitimate state transitions are reported rather than blindly required to be byte-identical.
expected_evidence: Approved platform identity, SMBIOS version and expected per-device handle policy
Per-device locator/array/population identity and raw sentinel or unique target resolution
Linked error fields plus address/device correlation and read-only EDAC/kernel context
Approved reboot/health evidence and post-reboot semantic state comparison without injection/clear

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The per-device handle has defined sentinel/reference semantics; expected live diagnostic state is a project input.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Sentinel and reference validation are fully automatable from read-only data.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds device identity, exact FFFEh/FFFFh meanings and unique Type 18/33 target correlation.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its safe no-injection approach while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE classification.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Allows legitimate diagnostic-state changes to be reported for engineer judgment instead of demanding blind byte equality.

review_improvement: Prevents a correct-looking handle from passing when associated with the wrong socket and avoids treating either defined sentinel as a broken reference.
independent_technical_reasoning: The handle is a discriminated 16-bit reference attached to an enumerable device record; classification and graph integrity are deterministic software checks.
